status: Synthetic movement-to-field feedback; no measured clay or human memory parameters

events.route: direct for generation 0; communicated account for descendants
experienced context; independent of biological ancestry
later re-exposure; no new claim of direct participation

ancestry_channel.reason: No human genetic or epigenetic transmission coefficient is established by the cited reference data. Generational attenuation here concerns communicated exposure, not inherited autobiographical memory.

interpretation: Retain accumulated A and every event record. Update diffusion and source-force gradients using actual deformation. Existing source caps, expression relaxation and upper-only paired exchange remain declared extensions. Material sources follow their material labels. No resets, new adoption/ancestry parameters or fitted restructuring gain.

feedback.diffusion_frame: isotropic current-space diffusion, pulled back and projected onto the angular field
feedback.gamma: physical displacement d divided by L; display magnification never enters dynamics
feedback.scope: Angular field reduction and one clay shear mode; not a full 2D fluid/contact model

sweep.rule: For factor r, active saturation b=b0/r^2, initial displacement=r*d0, and orbital RMS=r*F0. All source, memory, clay, spring and clock parameters stay fixed. Actual motion is measured, not imposed.
sweep.fixed_orbit_rule: Secondary controls keep orbital RMS at F0 while b and initial displacement use r; no-orbit paths provide duplicates.
sweep.interpretation: Synthetic amplitude stress test of the reduced equations, not a validated finite-strain clay law.
sweep.criteria_note: Operational screening bands selected before running; not statistical significance, physical thresholds or biological limits. Any band crossing must survive spatial/time refinement and both starts are reported separately.
sweep.refinements: All six primary scales at 64 cells and tighter time accuracy at 32 cells. Largest primary scale and both fixed-orbit controls also at 128 cells. If a rhythm band crossing occurs, test that scale at 128 cells too before calling it resolved.
sweep.repeat_scaling: Divide the four original scaled mechanical states by r before applying the unchanged .01 repeat tolerance. This avoids making a larger movement artificially harder to classify.
